speech_verification.heard: A wealthy Texas school chose free-waste gas to save money. Most people assume professionals inspected the gas system. Officials actually tapped a local residue line. Untreated gas carried no warning scent, hiding a leak beneath the floors. An electric sander then sparked the trapped fuel. Nearly 300 lives were lost, creating today's mercaptan laws. That tragedy happened because a wealthy Texas school chose free-waste gas.

notes.hook: The first line is a bit generic and the on-screen text mentions a specific dollar amount not found in research.
notes.payoff: The link to modern gas safety laws provides a satisfying conclusion.
notes.visuals: Images are historically accurate and clear.
notes.loop: The transition from beat 7 back to beat 1 is seamless.
notes.accuracy: The on-screen text '$300 SAVED' is an invention not supported by the research claims.

rewrite: On-screen text over beat 1: change '$300 SAVED, 300 LIVES LOST' to 'SAVING MONEY, LOSING LIVES'
